INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public)
VALUES ('expense-invoices', 'expense-invoices', true)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

-- Create the table to link expenses to their attachments in storage
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS expense_attachments (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    expense_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES expenses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    file_path TEXT NOT NULL,

);

CREATE POLICY "Allow authenticated user to upload attachments"
ON storage.objects FOR INSERT
WITH CHECK (

);

ON storage.objects FOR DELETE
USING (

  auth.role() = 'authenticated'
);

ON public.expense_attachments FOR SELECT
USING (
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM expenses e
    WHERE e.id = expense_id
  )
);

-- Allow users to insert attachments for expenses they own

ON public.expense_attachments FOR INSERT
WITH CHECK (

ON public.expense_attachments FOR DELETE
